title: K=3 CRRA REE h-FREE SMOOTH co-area operator validation
operator: A_v(p)=int_{P=p} f_v f_v/|grad P| dsigma via C2 natural-cubic tensor spline + FIXED Gauss-Legendre transverse nodes (decoupled from grid) + 1D smooth contour root-find (all roots) + partition-of-unity weights w2=d2P^2/(d2P^2+d3P^2), w3=d3P^2/(...)

validation_a_smoothness.verdict_hfree: slope-jump DECREASES as h->0 (A''*h) => SMOOTH, no kink
validation_a_smoothness.verdict_grid: slope-jump GROWS ~1/h as h->0 => true KINK at node values

validation_b_consistency.note: matches analytic co-area line integral to quadrature/spline accuracy ~1e-5; converges as G,Nq->inf. Also matches kernel h->0 limit (kernel ratio converges toward h-free value as h shrinks, but floors on the grid; h-free gives the limit directly).

smoothness_verdict: A_v(p) is SMOOTH (C1+) at former grid-node prices: the slope-jump DECREASES toward 0 as the probe width h->0 (consistent with A''*h), whereas BOTH grid methods (marching-squares scan, CDF-derivative) have a true KINK there: their slope-jump GROWS ~1/h. No kernel/bandwidth anywhere.
